biotools.summary: MultiModalGraphics is an R package for creating annotated scatterplots and heatmaps of multi-omics data, facilitating quantitative comparisons through the integration of statistical summaries. It interoperates with Bioconductor packages and streamlines workflows from data preprocessing to visualization.
